rationale_summary: The document primarily frames AI governance around protecting individual rights and human dignity—privacy, autonomy, informed consent, anti-discrimination, and fairness. The six core ethical requirements center on human welfare, equity, privacy protection, and human control, reflecting a fundamental rights framing. Secondary frames include social stability (harmonious human-machine relations, sustainable development, social justice) and consumer/public safety (controllability, accountability mechanisms).

evidence_spans.quote: 充分尊重个人信息知情、同意等权利，依照合法、正当、必要和诚信原则处理个人信息，保障个人隐私与数据安全
保障人类拥有充分自主决策权，有权选择是否接受人工智能提供的服务，有权随时退出与人工智能的交互
切实保护各相关主体合法权益，推动全社会公平共享人工智能带来的益处，促进社会公平正义和机会均等
充分考虑当前社会各界有关隐私、偏见、歧视、公平等伦理关切
